name: BulkBite Operations

provenance.rule: Confirmed evidence is interpreted explicitly; references contribute principles but never declare brand truth.

truth.intent: Make receiving, production use, and physical counts obvious to kitchen workers
evidence: Reviewed receipts, approved recipes, measured usage, physical counts, immutable stock events, and accountant exports
audienceNeeds: A quick way to receive stock, record what was used or left, and reconcile real stock
truth.category: Prepared-meal kitchen operations and stock control
truth.differentiation: BulkBite Operations treats the worker's physical count, receipt, and production measurement as the centre of the system, with accounting kept behind a clean export boundary.
antiPositioning: Automatic stock posting from unreviewed extraction
constraints: Frappe remains the host, authentication, database, permission, and API boundary
ERPNext is not installed and cannot be a runtime dependency
Worker documents create review drafts only and never post stock automatically
Every component job uses one selected Desyium owner and public System export
Frappe UI owns form and operational controls before shadcn-vue or project providers
No raster image inspection is used for design or validation

positioning.statement: A direct kitchen stock system that shows what should exist, records what arrived or was used, and keeps every approved movement traceable.
positioning.promise: Workers can record stock truth quickly, while managers can see the difference between recipe theory and the kitchen's actual numbers.
reasonsToBelieve: Reviewed receipts, approved recipes, measured usage, physical counts, immutable stock events, and accountant exports

tensions: immutable history and simple correction workflows
recognitionCues: neutral canvas and white work zones

hierarchy: Show the current stock or production state
Show the expected number beside the actual number
Name the evidence and the next explicit posting action

selectedTerritory.concept: A substantial kitchen field manual: stock truth is framed with the same bold, direct energy as the BulkBite customer brand, while dense work stays calm and legible.
selectedTerritory.sharedVisualGrammar: Neutral structural fields, white work surfaces, soft rounded boundaries, clear numeric evidence, compact operational labels, and one orange action signal per screen.
selectedTerritory.projectTranslationBoundary: References supply evidence and principles only; the approved project theme must be translated from this project's brief and must not copy a reference identity.

interpretations.source: BulkBite brand guide: substantial, straightforward, energetic, honest, and student-first
interpretations.meaning: Operational screens should feel recognisably BulkBite without sacrificing working clarity.
interpretations.implication: Scale, contrast, and one orange action establish hierarchy; controls remain familiar and explicit.
interpretations.expression: System-sans hierarchy, neutral canvas, white work surfaces, orange primary action, rounded geometry, and familiar controls.

interpretations.source: User requirement that handwritten worker records and receipt evidence enter the system safely
interpretations.meaning: Extraction is evidence assistance, not posting authority.
interpretations.implication: Every extracted row exposes source text, match confidence, warning, and human approval before it can reach a production or audit draft.
interpretations.expression: Evidence, review, and apply are separate reusable workflow blocks with explicit state.

proofPlan: Mounted Frappe UI form controls expose selected System exports and accessible states
Receipt, production, worker review, and audit blocks preserve one job and one posting boundary
Complete application proof covers dashboard, stock, plan, receipt, production, worker sheet, audit, scanner, and accountant export
